title: PRISM — R: Reality
description: Describes what the enterprise actually has and does — capabilities, systems, data assets, and processes.

id.description: ID of the artifact this depends on.

type.description: Type of artifact referenced. Used for blast radius analysis.

framework.description: Compliance framework identifier. Multiple can apply simultaneously.

scope.description: Which articles, controls, or aspects of this framework apply to this artifact.

status.description: Compliance status: applicable (must comply), certified (audited and confirmed), in-progress (working toward compliance), exempt (documented exception).

certification_date.description: Date certification or audit was completed.

capabilities.description: What the enterprise can do, expressed as business outcomes. Capabilities are independent of how they're delivered.

name.description: Capability name as a noun phrase (e.g., 'Claims Processing', 'Patient Discharge Management').

kind.description: Semantic kind of this artifact. Use when a capability closely represents a process, system, function, or AI agent. 'ai-agent' = capability delivered by an autonomous AI agent. Defaults to 'capability'.

status.description: Lifecycle status. 'decommissioning' = transition in progress. 'decommissioned' = retired but recorded for traceability.

classification.description: Information sensitivity classification for this capability.

system_ids.description: References to system IDs that deliver this capability.

depends_on.description: Artifacts this capability depends on. Used for blast radius analysis — when a dependency is decommissioned or changed, all dependent capabilities are flagged.

compliance_frameworks.description: Compliance frameworks applicable to this capability. Multiple can apply simultaneously.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering, indexing, and tooling (e.g., 'customer-facing', 'core', 'legacy').

systems.description: Operational units delivering capabilities — applications, machines, services, teams, or physical systems.

type.description: Classification of the system. 'team' and 'manual-process' support non-IT domains. 'ai-agent' = an autonomous AI system acting on behalf of a role. 'llm' = a large language model serving inference. 'agentic-workflow' = an orchestrated multi-agent pipeline.

status.description: Operational status. 'decommissioning' = transition in progress. 'decommissioned' = retired, recorded for blast radius and audit traceability.

classification.description: Information sensitivity classification for this system.

environment.description: Primary environment this system runs in (e.g., 'prod', 'staging'). Reference an environment ID from the people-place layer.

environment_ids.description: References to environment IDs from the people-place layer where this system is deployed.

integration_mode.description: How this system integrates with others: embedded (in-process coupling), handoff (transfers ownership to another system), deep-link (UI-level cross-system linking), api (synchronous interface), event (async messaging), batch (scheduled data transfer).

trigger_mode.description: How this system is initiated: manual (human triggers execution), scheduled (time-based cron/job), event-driven (triggered by an event or message), api-driven (triggered by an API call), continuous (always running, no discrete trigger), real-time (streaming, sub-second response). Useful for identifying automation opportunities.

depends_on.description: Artifacts this system depends on. Used for blast radius analysis — when a dependency is decommissioned or changed, all dependent systems are flagged.

compliance_frameworks.description: Compliance frameworks applicable to this system. Multiple can apply simultaneously.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering, indexing, and tooling.

data_assets.description: Core information assets, their owners, classifications, and roles in the enterprise.

classification.description: Data sensitivity classification. none = no sensitivity. public = freely shareable. internal = internal use only. proprietary = competitive or IP-sensitive. confidential = limited distribution. secret = highest sensitivity, strictest controls. restricted = access-controlled subset. regulated = subject to regulatory framework (use compliance_frameworks to specify which).

system_ids.description: Systems that store or process this data asset.

regulatory_constraints.description: Free-text list of applicable regulatory constraints (e.g., 'GDPR Art. 9', 'HIPAA PHI'). Use compliance_frameworks for structured capture.

compliance_frameworks.description: Structured compliance framework coverage for this data asset. Multiple can apply simultaneously.

depends_on.description: Artifacts this data asset depends on. Used for blast radius analysis.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering, indexing, and tooling.

processes.description: How work moves through the enterprise — workflows, procedures, value streams.

execution_mode.description: How this process is executed: manual (human-driven, no system automation), automatic (fully system-driven without human intervention), semi-automatic (human initiates or approves but system executes steps). Flag manual processes to identify automation candidates.

depends_on.description: Artifacts this process depends on. Used for blast radius analysis.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering, indexing, and tooling.
